en.title: Maximum Deliveries by One Truck with Halving Capacity
en.description:
A single truck has initial capacity T. Each time, choose any undelivered package whose weight is ≤ the current capacity; after it is delivered, the capacity is halved and rounded down. Maximize the number of packages delivered.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O and judging; ranges marked as this site's are not original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n T (1≤n≤100000, 1≤T≤10⁹), and the second line contains n weights (1..10⁹).
en.explanation: Example 1: 8, 4, 2, 1 in turn, delivering 4. Example 2: skip 9, deliver 8 and then 1, 2 in total. Example 3: both packages are heavier than the capacity 1, so 0 are delivered.
hints: Scan the weights from largest to smallest; if a package fits, deliver it and halve the capacity, otherwise skip it.
